thread:
jordan.se: hey team, hitting a 400 from the tool call API when invoking charge_customer. started ~09:15 UTC. error says schema validation failed (required + additionalProperties). payload below, can someone help repro?

zoe.support: thanks, can you paste the raw request id from the response headers or the logs (x-request-id)? also include the exact payload you sent.

jordan.se: x-request-id: req_5f9a2b1c. payload: ```json
{
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "args": {
    "amount": 12.00,
    "currency": "usd",
    "billing": {
      "profile": null
    },
    "metadata": {
      "order_id": "ord_123"
    },
    "unexpected_flag": true
  },
  "session": "sess_8"
}
```

jordan.se: error body from API: ```
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "schema validation failed",
  "details": [
    {"path": "data.billing.profile", "message": "required property 'id' is missing"},
    {"path": "data", "message": "additionalProperties 'unexpected_flag' is not allowed"},
    {"path": "data.amount", "message": "expected integer, got number"}
  ]
}
```

samir.eng: thanks for the repro, digging in. quick notes: 1) our schema requires billing.profile.id (string) when billing.profile exists; null isn't allowed. 2) amount must be integer (we expect cents), so 12.00 is a float — that triggers the type mismatch depending on validator. 3) additionalProperties is false at the top level of args so unexpected_flag gets rejected.

samir.eng: repro steps I ran using req id: pulled the request from logs, replayed the same payload via dev gateway, got identical errors. attaching the exact validator output from the runtime: ```
ValidatorError at /tools/charge_customer:
 - /args/amount: expected integer but got 12.0
 - /args/billing/profile: expected object with required property 'id'
 - /args: additional property 'unexpected_flag' not permitted
```

samir.eng: short-term options:
 - client-side: send amount in cents (e.g., 1200), remove unexpected_flag, and provide billing.profile.id if billing provided.
 - server-side: relax schema: allow billing.profile null OR make profile optional; allow additionalProperties for args.metadata, or provide clearer error messages mapping to our docs.

zoe.support: @jane.billing fyi — customer flow includes billing.profile sometimes null from checkout service. is profile.id optional in our business logic?

jane.billing: profile.id is required for charging — if checkout doesn't have a profile we should fallback to guest flow. client should not call charge_customer with billing.profile null.

mike.oncall: escalating to @oncall-team for potential server-side tolerance change and to check whether any other partners hit this. created incident INC-2025-834 and attached req_5f9a2b1c. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-team: acknowledged, taking a look. can the product team confirm if we want to relax the schema or force client change?

zoe.support: product says prefer failing fast — client should send correct shape. however we can make error messages clearer and update SDK docs.

samir.eng: ok — I'll open a small PR to improve error messages and add a validator hint (suggestion: include expected types and a guide URL). PR will also add a debug log with request id for these validation failures. will not relax required-ness yet.

samir.eng: proposed quick guard in runtime to return a 400 with a human-friendly summary: 
```
ValidationError: charge_customer args invalid. Issues: amount must be integer (cents); billing.profile must include id when present; unexpected fields not allowed — remove unexpected_flag. See https://redwood.ai/docs/tool-schema for examples. Request req_5f9a2b1c
```

jordan.se: made client changes (sent 1200 for amount, removed unexpected_flag, set billing.profile.id=\"pf_987\"). retried and it succeeded. thanks for the fast help.

zoe.support: great, closing the thread. opened follow-up doc ticket DOC-456 to update SDK example and add clear error mapping. :white_check_mark:

mike.oncall: INC-2025-834 closed after confirmation from customer.
